author: Gaming Desk
title: Indian gaming streamer KingAnshu hits record 150k live viewers during Mumbai esports showdown
description: A thrilling championship livestream broadcast from an arena in Mumbai, Maharashtra smashed regional Twitch viewership benchmarks.
content: The Mumbai event highlights the explosive growth of professional streaming across India.

author: Esports Staff
title: Bengaluru collegiate gaming championship draws record Twitch viewership across South Asia
description: Over 80 university teams competed in a multi-game tournament in Bengaluru, Karnataka, generating over 1.2 million hours watched on Twitch.
content: Twitch streaming metrics showed peak engagement across tech campuses in Karnataka and Maharashtra.
